pattern.description: On a plain off-white card, the headline 'Chat about anything' and the GPT-4 / Claude model line rise into place together from slightly below, fading in, and settle within roughly a third of a second.
pattern.why_premium: A short, decisive rise with a hard settle (no overshoot) on a calm neutral background makes the claim read instantly; the headline and supporting model badges arrive as one locked unit, keeping the typographic hierarchy intact.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo(['.headline', '.model-row'], {y: 60, autoAlpha: 0}, {y: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.02})
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [0, 10], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); apply translateY((1 - p) * 60px) and opacity p to the headline and model row (or spring({fps, frame, config: {damping: 200}}) for no overshoot).

notes: Headline and badges appear to move as one block (no visible per-word stagger); the filmstrip crop clips the text early in the move, so it may be a mask reveal from below rather than a fade. Slight overall scale (1.022) may indicate a small scale-down settle as well. No SFX candidates.
